posts.cooked:
So Sky-Scraper's outfit changes size with her, as evidenced by her not being naked in half her cards. I was thinking it might be some super-fabric she brought with her from home, but her new outfit on Extremist also changes size, as does, presumably, her bandana in the Prime Wars art.

So can she make other things change size as well, or is it just things that are in physical contact with her when she shifts?

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Absolute Zero is immortal, he is alive, yet cannot eat or drink or breathe.  He has innate magical powers that allow him to see, move and make sound.  Unless something manages to kill him, he will survive the heat death of the universe, where in spite of being horribly bored he will actually be comfortable.

His suit is also magical.  No amount of insulation or technology is going to allow a suit that thin to have one side be -273 and the other side 30 degrees without building up an incredible layer of ice nearly instantly.

 

Absolue Zero, therefore, must be not only immortal, but also the most powerful Magical human in the Multiverse.

posts.name: jagarciao
posts.cooked:
Absolute Zero's accident caused his body to become a portal to the Frost Dimension (he was saying his own name to himself right as the blast occurred and it served as a sort of summoning incantation). The sudden and extreme flow of energy between dimensions would tear his body apart and kill him as the dimensions sought find the energy equilibrium between them. The suit is not there to insulate but it's more of an interdimensional gate regulator. The energy and temperature differential on either side of the suit is because the two sides exist in different dimensions. 

 

That, or comics.
